integrity: The analytical proof establishes the universal assertion; bounded reproducibility diagnostics are separate consistency checks, not infinite certifications.
scientific_limitations: Fixed nonadaptive rank-one local product-projective readout of a specified fully separable mixed charger–battery state; only variance across conditional expected battery energies. No claim about adaptive LOCC, collective measurements, POVMs, collision dynamics, or intrinsic energy fluctuations. Quantitative novelty is qualified by prior local-orthogonality and graph-frustration work.
title: A sharp odd-cycle energy-readout variance floor for separable quantum chargers
